results.action: org.wikipedia.dev is already launched by the runner or by setup; do not use launcher search or intents. If onboarding appears, tap Forward until Skip is available, then tap Skip. From the main feed, tap the bottom Search tab (nav_tab_search) and stop there. Confirm the Search tab is selected and search_card is visible; do not tap search_card or enter SearchActivity.
results.comment: Initial layout showed main feed with Home selected and nav_tab_search at [540,2232]. Tapped Search. One UI dump returned a transient null-root error, then the fresh layout confirmed nav_tab_search selected and search_card visible at [540,302]; search_card was not tapped.
